requirements.description: User wants the dwelling located near public transport. The 75th percentile of the mobility distribution is 70.93, so the threshold is rounded to 71.
Energy class C or better, as requested. Covers classes A1 to A4, B and C. The 140 sqm floor area, 18-person capacity and public transport proximity are not energy requirements and were not included.
The user explicitly requires at least 140 sqm of gross floor area.

output.explanation: Applies the four extracted requirements: surface_area of at least 140 sqm, energy_class among A1–A4, B, C, mobility score of at least 71, and a 3.0 km radius around 45.0677551, 7.6824892 using the canonical latitude/longitude columns. Results are ordered by haversine distance from that point. The capacity and residential-type details in the user query were not among the extracted requirements, so they are not filtered on.
